panels.Notes:
Data and methods

  • Children: WorldPop 2026 100 m (140 M cells), ages per level × Government + Aided share (UDISE 2022).
  • Schools: UDISE 2022 Government + Aided (India); Sametham 2026-27 + HSCAP/VHSCAP (Kerala).
  • Norms: primary/LP 1 km, upper primary/UP 3 km (RTE Rules), secondary/HS 5 km (3 km hilly), higher secondary 7 km (Samagra Shiksha).
  • Seats per child: E2SFCA with Gaussian distance decay (σ = norm); norm-based seats (teachers × pupil–teacher norm), sensitivity = enrolment.
  • Priority areas (Kerala): connected 100 m cells with no school of the level within the norm, ≥ 50 children.
  • Computed with Apache Spark 3.5 + Sedona 1.9 (notebooks 24–28).
  • Kerala local bodies: OpenStreetMap has 1,027 of 1,034. The holes over 5 km² are grey with a dashed edge (Kilimanoor, Pazhayakunnummel, Nagaroor, Pulimath (Chirayinkeezhu taluk); Kanhangad, Nileshwaram (Hosdurg taluk); Chittariparamba (Thalassery taluk)); their people are counted in the district and taluk maps.

Exact sites for new schools were not optimised; they would also need land, cost and local data.
